messages:
Priya: quick design sync — tested the console on narrow widths (320–375px). two issues: table rows are truncating and the left nav pushes the content off-screen when open on mobile. screenshots attached.
Jae: thanks — saw the screenshots. looks like header row isn’t sticky when the sidebar overlays, so you lose column labels while scrolling.
Tom: is sidebar doing a push or overlay on the actual build? I thought we switched to overlay for < 480px.
Priya: current dev build is push for > 360 and overlay otherwise. on 320 it behaves like push due to the measurement bug.
Aisha: accessibility note — when the sidebar opens it steals focus but there isn’t an accessible close control that VoiceOver announces. also touch targets for the table row actions look < 44px.
Ben: for the table overflow, could we hide lower-priority columns and surface an overflow menu per-row? That keeps important columns visible and keeps density.
Tom: agree with hiding low-priority columns. we can implement a priority list: name, status, age, actions. everything else collapses into a kebab menu.
Jae: design suggestion — add a compact toggle in settings ("Compact rows") so users can choose tighter density. but default must meet touch targets.
Mike: implementation note — we can add horizontal scroll fallback for embedded widgets, but prefer column-priority collapse to avoid swipes inside the main scroll area.
Aisha: also propose aria-labels for the kebab menu as "More details for <row name>" and ensure keyboard focus lands inside the panel when opened.
Priya: copy tweak: change "Filters" to "Refine results" on small screens (shortens header and improves clarity). thoughts?
Ben: +1 on copy. shorter verb helps, but test in languages where it might expand.
Jae: mock attached: uses overlay sidebar with backdrop, 56px header height, and sticky table header. when overlay open, body behind should have inert=true.
Tom: quick CSS we can try for sticky header and horizontal fallback:
```
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.table thead { position: sticky; top: 56px; z-index: 5; }
```
Priya: looks good. can we also add a breakpoint tweak — treat <= 360px as "compact-mode" where we auto-collapse optional columns?
Mike: yes — we'll map width -> column profile server-side and client-side. fallback: if js fails, horizontal scroll keeps content reachable.
Aisha: don't forget to test with VoiceOver and TalkBack. also run a 200% zoom check to verify header overlap.
Ben: UX question — should the sidebar overlay use full-screen sheet on phones (like bottom sheet) or slide from left? slide from left keeps context for navigation but covers table; bottom sheet could be weird for nav.
Jae: prefer left slide for nav, but make it quick to close with a clear "Back" chevron and an invisible close tap target outside the sheet.
Priya: action items: Tom/Mike to fix push/overlay bug and implement column-priority collapse for <=360; Jae to update mock and add aria notes; Aisha to run accessibility checklist; Ben to test copy in i18n. deadline EOD Fri.
Tom: assigning myself and Mike. will open a tiny PR referencing this thread.
Mike: starting branch now. I’ll include the CSS snippet and a small JS breakpoint map.
design-bot: reminder — design review scheduled Friday 10:30am in #design. :calendar:
Priya: thanks all :thumbsup:
